sections.title: Contact Us
sections.content: Have questions about Sanatana Dharma? Need help understanding Vedic teachings? Want to collaborate or provide feedback? We welcome your message and aim to respond as soon as possible.

sections.title: How to Contact Sanatanadharmam
sections.content: You can contact us through email, phone, or by submitting the contact form below. We support global users and respond to inquiries related to Sanatana Dharma, philosophy, and website support.

sections.title: Send Us a Message
sections.description: Fill out the form below and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

sections.title: Response Time
sections.content: We typically respond within 24–48 hours. For detailed inquiries related to scriptures or collaborations, response time may vary.

sections.title: Why Contact Us?
points: Get answers to Sanatana Dharma questions
Collaborate on spiritual or educational content

faqs.question: How can I contact Sanatanadharmam?
faqs.answer: You can contact us via email, phone, or by using the contact form on this page.

faqs.question: Do you respond to all inquiries?
faqs.answer: Yes, we aim to respond to all genuine inquiries related to Sanatana Dharma and website support.

faqs.question: Can I collaborate or contribute content?
faqs.answer: Yes, we welcome collaborations, translations, and contributions related to Sanatana Dharma.

faqs.question: How long does it take to get a response?
faqs.answer: Most responses are provided within 24–48 hours.

volunteer.guidance: We welcome volunteers who can help with proofreading, typesetting, translations, audio recording, web development, and community moderation. Please describe your skills, availability, and any relevant samples of previous work. Submissions are reviewed and, if accepted, coordinated through a modest onboarding process so volunteers understand editorial standards and the project's code of conduct.
volunteer.heading: Volunteer and contribution guidelines

whattoinclude.guidance: To help us respond efficiently, please include: a clear subject line, the page or URL you are referring to (if applicable), a concise description of the issue or request, and your preferred contact method. For corrections to texts, indicate the exact line or verse and, if possible, provide a reliable source or edition reference. For translation suggestions, include both the suggested wording and brief reasoning for the change.
whattoinclude.heading: What to include in your message
